reviews.text: Once and never again! I booked an appointment and when I got there, the person responsible for grooming wasn't there. I had to reschedule, fine. I went two days later and according to them, they ran out of water. They could have communicated that. My pet's fur was very matted, and knowing that untangling it would hurt her, I asked them to keep it short, but they insisted on keeping the fur. Okay, after a 3-hour wait, they injured two of my pet's nipples, causing them to bleed. She got fleas, and not to mention the lack of hygiene, because it was a bath for her, they put her in the kennel instead of drying and grooming her. This was done with the other pets.

I left my Golden Retriever there at 3 PM for a bath only, it was a scheduled time, and they said she would be ready in 2 hours. At 3:38 PM I sent a message asking about it, and they said that nobody at the unit where I left her (on Joaquim Pinheiro) was attending to anyone. I told them to call because she had already been there for hours just for a bath. They said the demand was very high, which is already strange, since it's a scheduled appointment... I got in my car and went there to see what was happening... I arrived at 7 PM (4 hours after leaving her) and they said she had been ready for half an hour... and nobody had told me... and there was another time she stayed 5 hours just for a bath... so I said, "Wow, nobody told me she was ready... she's been here for 4 hours already..." The woman came to me arrogantly saying that she had peed and that they had to bathe her again. (Luna doesn't even pee like that in the street... she was just super stressed after being there for so long... I started arguing with the woman... the woman started getting stressed and wanted to hit me, and they had to hold her back... that place was absurd in every way... totally unprofessional... BEWARE! DON'T LEAVE YOUR PETS THERE!)

My two Shih Tzus were trapped in a CUBICLE because other kennels were full, which was already terrible. They said it would take about two and a half hours, and in TWO hours, the two hadn't even had a bath when I returned. To repeat, BOTH of them in a CUBICLE for TWO hours.

This is animal abuse, this is a lack of empathy for them.
If you don't love them or have the means to give them the bare minimum, simply don't do this kind of disservice. Shameful.
